    TERMS OF SERVICE

    LAST UPDATED:

    1. ACCEPTANCE

    By visiting this website, joining our Discord, or playing on Nexora RP (the “Service”), you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

    2. ELIGIBILITY

    You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age required to use Discord and Google services in your country, whichever is higher. If you are under the age of majority, you confirm that a parent or guardian allows you to use the Service.

    3. YOUR ACCOUNT

    You may sign in with Google. You are responsible for activity on your account and for keeping it secure. One person, one account — account sharing, selling or trading is not allowed.

    4. COMMUNITY CONDUCT

    • Treat everyone with respect. Harassment, hate speech, discrimination, threats and doxxing are not tolerated.
    • No cheating, hacking, modding for unfair advantage, or exploiting bugs. Report bugs to staff instead.
    • Follow the in-game and Discord rules, including fair roleplay rules (for example, no random violence and no breaking character to gain an advantage).
    • No illegal content, spam, scams or advertising without staff permission.
    • Follow staff instructions. Staff decisions are made to keep the community fair and are final unless an appeal is granted.

    5. ROLEPLAY & FICTION

    Nexora RP is a fictional roleplay environment. Events, characters and scenarios in the game are fictional and do not represent real people or real endorsement of any behavior.

    6. VIRTUAL ITEMS & SUPPORT

    In-game items, currency, vehicles, properties and progress have no real-world value, are not property, and cannot be exchanged for money. If paid perks or donations are offered in the future, they are voluntary, support server costs, and are non-refundable unless required by law. Characters and progress may be reset when needed for balance, updates or technical reasons.

    7. YOUR CONTENT

    You keep ownership of content you create (such as clips, screenshots and stories). By posting it in our community, you give Nexora RP a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to display and share it for community and promotional purposes. You confirm you have the right to share it.

    8. SUSPENSION & TERMINATION

    We may warn, mute, suspend or permanently ban users, and remove content or access, at our discretion, especially for rule violations or to protect the community and Service.

    9. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

    The Nexora RP name, logo, website and original content belong to Nexora RP. Nexora RP is an independent community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All third-party trademarks belong to their respective owners.

    10. DISCLAIMER & LIABILITY

    The Service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind. It may change, be interrupted, or be discontinued. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Nexora RP and its staff are not liable for indirect or consequential damages, or for loss of data, progress or access arising from your use of the Service.

    11. CHANGES

    We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms.

    PRIVACY POLICY

    LAST UPDATED:

    This policy explains what information Nexora RP collects, how we use it, and the choices you have.

    1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT

    • Account information: if you choose “Continue with Google”, we receive your name, email address and profile picture from Google through our authentication provider. We never receive your Google password.
    • Game & community data: once the game launches, this may include your in-game identifiers, character data, gameplay activity, chat and moderation records.
    • Technical data: basic information such as device type, browser, IP address and error logs, used to keep the Service secure and working.

    2. HOW WE USE IT

    • To sign you in and show your profile on the site.
    • To run, secure and improve the Service and game.
    • To enforce rules, prevent cheating and abuse, and handle appeals.
    • To send important service announcements. We do not sell your data or send third-party advertising.

    3. SHARING

    We share data only with service providers needed to operate the Service (such as our authentication, hosting and database providers), when required by law, or to protect the safety and rights of our community. We do not sell personal information.

    4. COOKIES & LOCAL STORAGE

    The site uses only what is needed for sign-in sessions and basic functionality. Our authentication provider may store a session in your browser. You can clear this at any time in your browser settings or by logging out.

    5. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES

    Links to Discord, YouTube, Instagram and Google lead to services with their own privacy policies. We are not responsible for their practices.

    6. DATA RETENTION & SECURITY

    We keep data only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law, and we use reasonable safeguards to protect it. No online service can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

    7. YOUR CHOICES & RIGHTS

    You can log out at any time. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under local privacy laws.

    8. CHILDREN

    Nexora RP is not intended for children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

    9. CHANGES

    We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do.
